title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 7 in E-flat major

character.text: Light, modern fugue with violin-sonata figuration and a concerto-like plan

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 12–17).
sections.leads: From E♭ major to B♭ major

sections.label: Subject in B♭ major, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 7–10) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the bass, the bass's line in the soprano, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to C minor; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 17

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From C minor to B♭ major

sections.label: Subject in B♭ major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to E♭ major

sections.label: Subject in E♭ major, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From E♭ major to B♭ major

sections.label: Subject in B♭ major, rhythm varied (Alto)
Episode 7
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in E♭ major at bar 37

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
